figurative_meaning_en: To become distraught and directionless with worry due to sudden misfortune
example_sentences_in_bangla: চাকরিটা হারিয়ে তার মাথায় আকাশ ভেঙ্গে পড়েছে।
পরীক্ষায় ফেল করে ছেলেটির মনে হলো মাথায় আকাশ ভেঙ্গে পড়ল।
example_sentences_in_english: Losing his job made the sky fall on his head.
Failing the exam felt like the sky crashing down on the boy's head.
note: This idiom vividly captures the overwhelming sense of catastrophe in Bengali expressive culture.
